data.narrative:
Bohr Systems is a pre-seed stage company in Defense & Security, founded by Rohil Gharat (former Cisco, Antler, Founders Inc.) and Samarth Kumbla (Columbia CS '27). The valuation landscape for this company draws from a broader Defense & Security sector comprising 23 same-sector peers, including 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers. Top-tier private reference points include Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems.

Traditional peer-median valuation proved inapplicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the Defense & Security sector. No subset of three or more peers meeting strict stage and tier filters could be identified, making sector-wide median benchmarking unreliable. The fragmented maturity distribution across the 23 same-sector peers—ranging from pre-seed through late-stage—creates too much dispersion to anchor a credible valuation on median multiples or round sizes.

Without sufficient narrow-set triangulation, valuation of Bohr Systems cannot be supported by quantitative methodology at this time. A credible analysis would require either (1) expansion of stage-agnostic comparables with explicit discount factors for stage mismatch, (2) accumulation of additional recent pre-seed data from Defense & Security, or (3) reliance on founder-quality and team composition heuristics rather than financial multiples. Current data constraints preclude a point estimate or defensible range.
